items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: Yeah, that Ransom. Yeah, I knew him.

ctx.x: He played imperial all the time. I don't remember him.
This fellow, he's broke up out here to play a rubber show, Ransom. He's a wonderful bass player. Yeah, that Ransom. Yeah, I knew him.
How much did you get paid, say, with Clyde Carr's band? Practically nothing?
